Matrices that soak up a concentrated low-rank change under that recipe do so for both rewards, so the two share a per-matrix top-8-share fingerprint. Code-RL 3.1 already tracks Math 3.1 closely elsewhere: token-level log-prob agreement 0.405 (result-eb9211), and F27 notes the input-subspace overlap with Think-SFT is shared by Code 3.1. result-caa23d already measured Math 3.1's fingerprint on these exact 224 family-median-removed matrices: it follows Think-SFT (rho 0.594) and not IF-RL (rho -0.010), so rho(T) - rho(I) = +0.604. If Code 3.1's pattern is Math 3.1's pattern plus noise that is unrelated to Think-SFT and IF, then D3 = rho(Code, Math 3.1) x 0.604. With the Code-Math rank correlation of about 0.5-0.7 that sibling runs should have, that gives about 0.30-0.42, inside [0.15, 1.0]. None of this needs a Code-specific mechanism; it needs only the shared recipe and the Math 3.1 result.

This should reproduce result-caa23d: 0.594 - (-0.010) = 0.604. 4) Compute r_CM = Spearman rho(Code 3.1, Math 3.1) over the same 224 residuals. 5) Predicted D3 = r_CM x D_M.
